full_judgment: 2. Short fact of the case is that the respondent No. 1 as the plaintiff filed the Title Suit No. 172 of 2000 in the Court of The Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka alleging, inter-alia, that decree passed on 14.08.1972 in Title Suit No. 64 of the Court of First Subordinate Judge, Dhaka was obtained by practising fraud and forgery upon the Court by the defendant No. 1 and as such the same is void and not binding on the Government for a declaration that the judgment dated 10.04.1997 passed in Writ Petition No. 2456 of 1996 and Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 744 of 1997 on the basis of the aforesaid decree in Title Suit No. 64 of 1972 were also obtained by practising fraud and forgery on the Court and are therefore inoperative, null and void and have no legal force and as such not binding upon the plaintiff and for a further declaration that the schedule No. 1 property was not the subject matter of the solenama decree in the Title Suit No. 64 of 1972 a decree for permanent injunction restraining the defendant No. 1 from claiming or demanding or interfering with and /or disturbing the possession of the plaintiff in schedule No,  property and to award cost of the suit and to pass such other and further order or orders as court may deem fit and proper as per law and equity.
